name: Aircraft
description: May only use Advance actions, moving in a straight line, and adding 30” to its total move (even if Shaken). Aircraft ignore all units and terrain when moving and stopping, can’t seize or contest objectives, can’t be charged, and units targeting them get -12” range.

name: Ambush
description: May be set aside before deployment. At the start of any round after the first, may be deployed fully within 6” of any table edge, over 9" away from enemy units. Players alternate in placing Ambush units, starting with the player that activates next. Units that deploy via Ambush can’t seize or contest objectives on the round they deploy.

name: AP
description: Targets get -X to Defense rolls when blocking hits.

name: Artillery
description: May only use Hold actions. When this model shoots at enemies over 9" away, it gets +1 to hit rolls. When enemy units shoot at this model from over 9" away, they get -2 to hit rolls.

name: Bane
description: Ignores Regeneration, and when attacking the target must re-roll unmodified Defense results of 6.

name: Banner
description: This model and its unit get +1 to morale test rolls.

name: Blast
description: Ignores cover, and after resolving other special rules, each hit is multiplied by X, where X is up to as many hits as models in the target unit.

name: Caster
description: Gets X spell tokens at the start of each round, but can’t hold more than 6 tokens at once. At any point before attacking, spend as many tokens as the spell’s value to try casting one or more spells (only one try per spell). Roll one die, on 4+ resolve the effect on a target in line of sight in any direction. Models within 18” in line of sight of the caster’s unit may spend any number of spell tokens at the same time before rolling, to give the caster +1/-1 to the roll per token.

name: Counter
description: Strikes first with this weapon when charged, and the charging unit gets -1 total Impact rolls per model with Counter in the two front rows if charging in the front.

name: Deadly
description: Assign each wound to one model, and multiply it by X. Hits from Deadly must be resolved first, and these wounds don’t carry over to other models if the original target is killed.

name: Entrenched
description: As long as a unit where all models have this rule hasn't moved during the round, enemy units shooting at it from over 9" away get -2 to hit rolls.

name: Fast
description: Moves +2" when using Advance, and +4” when using Rush/Charge.

name: Fear
description: This model counts as having dealt +X wounds when checking who won melee.

name: Fearless
description: When a unit where all models have this rule fails a morale test, roll one die. On a 4+ it counts as passed instead.

name: Flying
description: May move through units and terrain, and ignores terrain effects whilst moving.

name: Furious
description: When charging, unmodified results of 6 to hit in melee deal 1 extra hit (only the original hit counts as a 6 for special rules).

name: Hero
description: Heroes with up to Tough(6) may deploy as part of one multi-model unit without another Hero. The hero may take morale tests on behalf of the unit, but must use the unit’s Defense until all other models have been killed.

name: Immobile
description: May only use Hold actions.

name: Impact
description: Models in the two front rows roll X dice when attacking after charging, unless fatigued. For each 2+ the target takes one hit.

name: Indirect
description: Gets -1 to hit rolls when shooting after moving. May target enemies that are not in line of sight as if in line of sight, and ignores cover from sight obstructions.

name: Limited
description: May only be used once per game.

name: Morale
description: Gets +X to morale test rolls.

name: Musician
description: This model and its unit moves +1" when using move actions.

name: Regeneration
description: When a unit where all models have this rule takes wounds, roll one die for each. On a 5+ it is ignored.

name: Relentless
description: When this model shoots at enemies over 9" away, unmodified results of 6 to hit deal 1 extra hit (only the original hit counts as a 6 for special rules).

name: Reliable
description: Attacks at Quality 2+.

name: Rending
description: Ignores Regeneration, and on unmodified results of 6 to hit, those hits get AP(+4).

name: Scout
description: May be set aside before deployment. After all other units are deployed, may be deployed anywhere fully within 12” of their deployment zone. Players alternate in placing Scout units, starting with the player that activates next.

name: Slow
description: Moves -2" when using Advance, and -4” when using Rush/Charge.

name: Sniper REMOVE
description: Shoots at Quality 2+, and each model with Sniper may pick any model in the target unit as its individual target, which is resolved as if it was a unit of 1. Sniper shooting must be resolved before other weapons.

name: Stealth
description: When units where all models have this rule are shot from over 9" away, enemy units get -1 to hit rolls.

name: Strider
description: May ignore the effects of difficult terrain when moving.

name: Takedown
description: This model may pick any model in the target unit as its individual target, which is resolved as if it was a unit of [1]. Takedown attacks must be resolved before other weapons.

name: Thrust
description: When charging, gets +1 to hit rolls and AP(+1) in melee.

name: Tough
description: This model must take X wounds before being killed. If a model with tough joins a unit without it, then it is removed last when the unit takes wounds. You must continue to put wounds on the tough model with most wounds in the unit until it is killed, before starting to put them on the next tough model (heroes must be assigned wounds last, even if already wounded).

name: Transport
description: May transport up to X models or Heroes with up to Tough(6), and non-Heroes with up to Tough(3) which occupy 3 spaces each. Transports may deploy with units inside, and units may enter/exit by using any move action, but must stay fully within 6" of it when exiting. Units inside/outside transports may not target other units outside/inside transports, but may target the transport itself. When a transport is destroyed, units inside must take a dangerous terrain test, are Shaken, and must be placed fully within 6” of the transport before it’s removed.

name: Unstoppable
description: Ignores Regeneration, and ignores all negative modifiers to this weapon.

name: Highborn
description: This model gets +4"/+2" range when shooting/charging.

name: Shielded Aura
description: This model and its unit get Shielded.

name: Enhanced Highborn
description: If this model has Highborn, it gets +8"/+4" range when shooting/charging from Highborn (instead of only +4"/+2").

name: Vanguard
description: After this model is deployed, it may be placed anywhere fully within 9" of its position, over 9" away from non-Vanguard enemy units.

name: Sergeant
description: This model gets AP(+1) when attacking.

name: Armor
description: Counts as having Defense X+.

name: Bane when Shooting
description: This model gets Bane on its weapons when shooting.

name: Enhanced Highborn Aura
description: This model and its unit get Enhanced Highborn.

name: Hit & Run
description: Once per round, this model may move by up to 3" after shooting or being in melee.

name: Shred in Melee Aura
description: This model and its unit get Shred on its weapons in melee.

name: Relentless Aura
description: This model and its unit get Relentless.

name: Fearless Aura
description: This model and its unit get Fearless.

name: Bounding
description: When this unit is activated, you may move all models with this rule in it by up to D3+1".

name: Slayer
description: When using Hold actions and shooting, or when charging, this model's weapons get AP(+2) if most models in the target have Tough(3) or higher.

name: Quick Shot
description: If most models in this unit have this rule, they may use Rush actions to move sideways or backward (by up to half their move), and may shoot after using Rush actions.

name: Anti-Cover
description: This weapon ignores Cover.

name: Spell Conduit
description: Casters within 12" that are from other friendly units may cast spells as if they were in this model's position, and get +1 to casting rolls when doing so. Friendly casters may only use this rule if this unit isn't Shaken.

name: Spell Resistance
description: When a unit where most models have this rule takes wounds, roll one die for each. If the wound was from a spell, then it is ignored on a 2+. If the wound was not from a spell, then it is ignored on a 6+ instead.

name: Cumbersome
description: May only use Hold or Advance actions, but can’t shoot when moving.

name: Piercing Tag
description: Once per game, during this model's activation, before attacking, place X tokens on one enemy unit within 24" and in line of sight, or one token on X enemy units within 24" and in line of sight. When attacking, friendly units may remove one token from their target before rolling to block to get AP(+1) on their weapons.

name: Fracture
description: For each unmodified result of 6 to hit, those hits get AP(+2).

name: Precision Debuff
description: Once per activation, before attacking, pick one enemy unit within 18" in line of sight, which gets -1 to hit rolls when attacking once (next time the effect would apply).

name: Crossing Strike
description: Once per activation, when this model moves through enemy units, pick one of them and attack it with this weapon as if it was shooting. This weapon may only be used in this way.

name: Unstoppable
description: This weapon ignores Regeneration, and ignores all negative modifiers which are not from this model's special rules.

name: Precision Shooting Mark
description: Once per activation, before attacking, pick one enemy unit within 18" in line of sight, which friendly units get +1 to hit rolls when shooting against once (next time the effect would apply).

name: Extra Reach
description: This model gets +4"/+2" range when shooting/charging.

name: Enhanced Extra Reach
description: If this model has Extra Reach, it gets +8"/+4" range when shooting/charging from Extra Reach (instead of only +4"/+2").

name: Shielded
description: Units where most models have this rule get +1 to Defense rolls against hits that are not from spells.

name: AP
description: AP

name: Defense
description: This model gets +X to Defense rolls.

name: Bane
description: Ignores Regeneration, and when attacking, the target must re-roll unmodified Defense results of 6.

name: Shred
description: For each unmodified result of 1 to block hits, this weapon deals 1 extra wound.

name: Relentless
description: When this model shoots at enemies over 9” away, unmodified result of 6 to hit deal 1 extra hit (only the original hit counts as a 6 for special rules).

name: Fear
description: When in melee with this model, enemies count as having taken +X wounds when checking who won.

name: Fearless
description: When a unit where most models have this rule fails a Morale Test, roll one die. On a 4+ it counts as passed instead.

You must continue to put wounds on the Tough model with most wounds in the unit until it is killed, before starting to put them on the next Tough model (Heroes must be assigned wounds last, even if already wounded).

Pick a target and roll one die, and on 4+ resolve the spell’s effect. Models within 18” of the Caster may spend any number of spell tokens at the same time before rolling to give the Caster +1/-1 to the roll per token.
